newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish 1996 average unemployment fell to 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Danish 1996 average unemployment fell to 8.8 pct.

text.p: Denmark's unemployment was on average 8.8 percent of the workforce or 245,600 jobless in 1996, the National Statistics Office said on Thursday.
By December 1996, the Danish unemployment rate had fallen to 8.1 percent of the workforce from 9.2 percent in January.
Average unemployment in Denmark was 10.3 percent in 1995 and 12.2 percent in 1994.
In its last forecast in December, the Danish Economy Ministry foresaw 1996 unemployment of 8.8 percent. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
